attributes.name: Bolstering Armor
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage to you by 2. You may draw up to 2 cards.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if you are proficient with light armors, bury this card instead.

If you are proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armor Bolstering Armor, add the following as a new first power: "Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2. You may draw up to 2 cards."
corrections.issue: Why is Bolstering Armor not as good as Lesser Bolstering Armor?
